name: Line trend
summary: 1–2 series over time: monotone curve draw-in, gradient area wash, end-of-line labels.

slots.label: What is measured
slots.tooltip: A short caption over the chart that says what the lines measure, like capability per dollar

slots.label: Time labels
slots.tooltip: The marks along the bottom, left to right, like years or months. Each line needs one number per mark

item.label: Mark
item.tooltip: One mark along the bottom, like 2024 or Mar

slots.label: Lines
slots.tooltip: One or two lines to draw across the chart. Each has a name and its numbers

item.label: Name
item.tooltip: What this line stands for, written at its right-hand end

item.label: Numbers
item.tooltip: The line's numbers, one for each time label, left to right

item.label: Colour
item.tooltip: Pick a colour for this line, or leave it empty to take the next colour after the slide's

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The slide's accent colour: the first line wears it

provenance.note: The demo is the authored "capability per dollar" chart, carried.
